figures.notes: Panel A clearly displays 9-band YJH synthetic recovery completeness across 1,620 trials with labeled 1064.1 nm Nd:YAG/Yb and 1550.0 nm Er C-band vertical reference lines; Panel B highlights the 0%->74.1% (at 9 sigma_exp) and 11.1%->100.0% (at 14 sigma_exp) Keplerian de-Doppler Channel K_PLANET sensitivity boost over uncompensated Channel T_DIFF across 135 planetary-track trials; Panel C shows 100.0% (72/72) true-laser pass rate and 100.0% (72/72 + 72/72) Hawaii-2RG IPC hot-pixel and persistence/bandhead-plateau rejection.

Panel A illustrates the logarithmic four-generation near-IR false-alarm collapse across all 152 NIRPS_HE exposures from Legacy V2 (736 control + 3,092 science = 3,828 false alarms) and V3.3 G1 (685 control + 3,368 science = 4,053 seeds) down to 0 control and 0 qualified science candidates after Gates G2_V33-G5_V33; Panel B separates G2 telluric/OH airglow vetoes (n=3,999), G3 chromospheric/cross-star molecular ridge vetoes (n=48), and G4/G5 sky-subtraction/H2RG 2D vetoes (n=6).

Panel A presents the joint ESPRESSO (0.38-0.78 um, R=140,000) + NIRPS_HE (0.98-1.80 um, R=70,000) <2 pc panchromatic upper limits on Proxima Centauri (9.0 W optical; 607.7 W at 1064.1 nm; 1,026.1 W at 1550.0 nm) and Barnard's Star (23.6 W optical; 1,569.7 W at 1064.1 nm; 2,016.0 W at 1550.0 nm) with clean non-overlapping lower-right legend; Panel B displays all 162 star-band 2MASS (J, H)-calibrated 8-sigma transmitter power curves across the 18 D082 exoplanet hosts.

Panel A maps best 8-sigma 10 m beamed CW laser power limits versus Gaia DR3 distance across all 66 science stars in the unified D079-D082 V3 survey (highlighting the 29-star <10 pc solar neighborhood, Proxima Centauri, Barnard's Star, eps Eri, tau Cet, and Teegarden's Star); Panel B displays the complete 80-unique-star (501-exposure, 2992-6327 K) HR/distance census across HARPS, ESPRESSO, and NIRPS_HE.
